seal.statement: Each whole-tree metric (complexity, cognitive complexity, import cycles, duplication, file size, unused exports) is computed once per push cycle by one producing command, and every other consumer reads that production's report instead of recomputing it: each report records the source digest of the tree it was produced from, a consumer verifies that digest against the live tree and refuses rather than trusting a stale report, the gate orders the producer before its consumers, and a consuming run is distinguishable from a producing one so the budget can tell them apart; the budget row duplicate_metric_productions reads zero, and the reduction cites the measurement it is compared against.
